Error.description: A refusal, in the common error shape.

kind.description: What it is read as: `image`, `audio`, `video`, `text`, `page` or `file`.

name.description:
The name it is shown and named by in the body; a last part such as `-ko` before the extension is the
language it is in.

role.description:
The caller's word for its part in the document; `head` marks a file a reader is shown at a markdown
document's head, a sound in the listen band. A page stands its sounds where it writes them.

AttachmentPage.description: A page of attachments, in the order they were kept.

CompanyUnit.description: One unit of a company's tree, as the account service names it.

id.description: The unit's number, as the account service numbers it.

parent.description: The unit it stands directly under; null for the company.

CompanyUnits.description: The units of a document owner's company, which the document may be shared with.

company.description: The company's number, the unit at the top of its tree.

units.description:
Every unit of the company: the company first, each unit after its parent, siblings in the account service's
order.

description.description:
What it reads as before it is opened: a page's declared description, else the opening prose of its
body, cut at 160 characters; null where it has none.

hasPicture.description: Whether it keeps a picture, so its cover picture has one to send.

owner.description:
The account key of the account that owns it, as `Owner-Key` named it when it was filed; null for a document
with no owner (`docs/artifact.md`, "Owners").

permission.description:
For an account reader that reads the document alone, through a share or as the administrator reading one
another account owns, the permission it reads it under; absent where the reader reaches it wholly, and in
every event (`docs/api.md`, "Readers").

scope.description: What it is held under; null where none was given.

DocumentChange.description:
A document rewritten under its number: each field given replaces its own, and the labels replace the
labels whole.

body.description: The markdown body, for every kind but a page.

description.description: What it reads as before it is opened, where the filer says it; else it is read out of the body or the page.

title.description: Its title; a page with a `title` element of its own may leave it empty.

DocumentKind.description: One kind a document may be filed as.

contentsDepth.description: How many levels of its headings its table of contents lists, 0 for none.

hosted.description: Whether a document of this kind is the HTML page it keeps, filed as `html` and opened as that page.

icon.description: The icon the screens draw the kind by, a name of the Material Symbols set.

DocumentKindPage.description: A page of kinds, in the catalogue's order.

DocumentPage.description: A page of documents, newest first.

DocumentReads.description: One of the documents most read, and how many reads it has in the last seven days.

reads.description: How many reads it has in the last seven days, one a reader's day.

DocumentReadsPage.description: A page of the documents most read, the most first.

Error.description: A failure: its kebab-case code and its English sentence.

Event.description: One event: its number, its kind, when it was kept and the member it is about.

data.description: The member as a read answers it, or its key alone for a removal.

EventPage.description: A page of events, oldest first.

reason.description: Why the service is not ready; null when it is.

documentId.description: The document it filed; null until it is filed.

title.description: The document's title; the page's own where none is given.

LabelValue.description: One value a label holds, and how many documents carry it.

LabelValuePage.description: A page of a label's values, the most carried first.

MemberShare.description: One member a document is shared with.

user.description: The member's account key, as the console writes `Owner-Key`.

MemberShareChange.description: A member share's permission set anew.

MemberShareInput.description: The members to share a document with, and what they may do with it.

users.description: The members' account keys: 1 to 200, each of 1 to 200 characters.

MemberSharePage.description: A page of member shares, in the order they were shared.

Permission.description:
What a member a document is shared with may do with it (`docs/api.md`, "Member shares"): `read` is given,
and `edit` is named so that asking for it is refused rather than misread.

Publication.description: A document filed and a link to it opened in one call: what a document is handed to somebody as.

share.description:
The link that opens it, with no end: it names the document, so it serves the body the document stands
with whenever it is opened.

RecentRead.description: A document the reader read last, and when.

readAt.description: When the reader last opened it, in milliseconds since the epoch.

RecentReadsPage.description: A page of the documents the reader read last, the one opened last first.

Reference.description: A page a document refers to.

preview.description: The description the page declares for a preview.

title.description: The page's title as the document or its preview gives it.

ReferencePage.description: A page of references, in the document's order.

ScopeCounts.description: How many members of each resource a scope holds.

ScopeHolding.description: What the service holds under one scope, counted by resource.

state.description: Null for a read, `released` once let go of, `preview` for a dry run.

expiresAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; null for a link with no end.

url.description: The share address, a `/` and the token.

ShareHead.description:
What a live link reads as before it is opened (`docs/api.md`, "Share links"): the values a console writes
into the head of the page it serves at the link's address.

description.description:
The document's description, led by its kind's word where the page names the kind over the title; absent
where the document has none.

image.description: The share read of the cover picture, carrying the token; absent where the document keeps none.

kind.description: The word the page names the document's kind by; absent where the page names none.

locale.description: The locale of the language the words are in, as Open Graph writes one: `ko_KR`.

siteName.description: The name the card stands under.

title.description: The document's title, as the page shows it.

expiresAt.description: When it stops opening, in epoch milliseconds; none for a link with no end.

SharePage.description: A page of live links, oldest first.

StorageEntry.description: A link's entry of the storage setting, as the account service answers it.

lockedBy.description: The farthest link above holding a lock, where one does.

value.description: The link's own value, none where it follows above.

writable.description: Whether the caller may change the entry now.

StorageField.description: One setting a kind of place takes beside its name.

required.description: Whether a value naming the place must give it.

StorageFieldShape.description: The shape a storage place's field takes.

StorageInput.description:
A link's storage value written: an object naming its kind in `place` and its settings beside it, or null to
follow the link above.

StoragePlace.description: One kind of place a document's files may be kept at (`docs/artifact.md`, "Places").

description.description: What it is, in one English sentence.

StoragePlaces.description: Every kind of place, in the catalogue's order.

StorageRule.description: One rule of a link of the delegation chain: whom it names and its value.

UnitShare.description: One organisation unit a document is shared with.

unit.description: The unit's number, as the account service numbers it.

UnitShareInput.description: The organisation units to share a document with, each to read it.

units.description: The units' numbers: 1 to 200 of them.

UnitSharePage.description: A page of unit shares, in the order they were shared.

bearer.description: The service's token, or the console's, as the settings name them; the console's reaches each operation as its x-console says, under the Owner-Role and Owner-Key headers where it is a screen's; the console face, its x-console face, takes the console's alone.

info.description: Documents kept, searched and shared: records, learning books, imports and pages, each with its body, attachments, references and cover picture; share links that open a document for whoever holds the token; page imports read through bmo-explorer's client. The paths carry no prefix; whatever serves the service to a browser mounts it under its own.

x-tools.description: Publish a document as an artifact: file it and answer with a permanent share link to hand to a reader. Takes its title, a short description, and its words as markdown `body` or as the `path` of a file on this machine. The link has no end and opens with no console login; it keeps opening across restarts and redeployments, and it names the document rather than a body, so a rewrite keeps the same link serving the newest body.

input.description: A document to publish: what it is called, what it reads as, and its words, given or read off this machine.

body.description: Its words as markdown, for a record or a learning book; the page's HTML for a page.

description.description: What it reads as before it is opened, in a line or two.

kind.description: The kind it is filed as: `record` where none is named, `learning` or `page` beside it.

path.description: A file on this machine whose whole text is the body, or the HTML of a page, given instead of `body`.

scope.description: What it is held under, where the caller keeps one.
